metadata.title: High-Contrast Split Portrait with Glitch Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast black and white portrait bisected by a vertical seam, flanked by vertically stacked glitch-distorted sans-serif characters.
excludeWhen: colorful or vibrant palettes are requested
traditional horizontal text layout is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, high-key black and white image featuring a central female subject in a white bodysuit, arms crossed, with a distinct vertical line splitting the frame. The composition is framed by large, bold, black letters on either side that exhibit horizontal digital glitch offsets.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical bisection of the central subject
High-contrast relationship between white background and black graphic elements
Interaction between organic human form and geometric glitch text
coreInvariants: Vertical split line through the center of the subject
High-key white background with no visible environment
Glitch-style horizontal displacement on all typographic characters

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central, medium-shot portrait occupying the middle third of the horizontal space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vertical seam line running through the subject's face and torso.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central face, move down the vertical split, then scan the flanking vertical text columns.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white negative space surrounding the subject and between the text elements.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for shadows and typography
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone grays in the subject's skin and hair
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value contrast between highlights and shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Horizontal slices shifted left or right to create a glitch effect
characterSpecificRedesigns: G and R feature sharp, angular cuts
E and F have elongated horizontal bars with offset segments
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for all display elements to maintain brutalist consistency.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary heavy skeleton for glitch modification.
Geometric clarity works well with the stark composition.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white portrait of a woman in a white bodysuit against a white background, with a sharp vertical line splitting the image down the center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add vertically stacked, heavy sans-serif letters on the left and right sides, applying horizontal slice-and-shift glitch effects to each character.

verificationChecks: Is there a clear vertical split through the subject?
Do the letters have horizontal glitch offsets?

adjustableVariables: Width of the central split line

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp edges on graphic elements

postGenerationChecks: Verify the vertical split is perfectly centered.
Ensure the text is legible despite the glitch effect.
Check that the background is pure white without gradients.
Confirm the subject's skin tones are rendered in high-contrast grayscale.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-key monochrome portrait + vertical bisection + flanking vertical glitch typography.
